<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors where one value is twice the other. The measured total resistance between A and X1 is 6.667 Ω, so letting the smaller resistor be R, we have R + 2R = 3R = 6.667 Ω → R ≈ 2.222 Ω and the larger resistor ≈ 4.445 Ω. The simplest topology that matches this description is a series connection of the two resistors between A and X1, with an intermediate node (named B).</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.445}, "connections": [["A", "B", "R1"], ["B", "X1", "R2"]]}</final_answer>
